messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER: [SEV1] High 502/504 rate observed at api-gateway-eu-west (edge tier). Triggered by health of edge-nginx pool. On-call: sarah. Runbook: http://runbooks.internal/edge-502

sarah: Ack. jumping on now. :rotating_light:

ops-bot: Auto-detected: 5xx spike start=7432109000 window=5m rate=11.4% -> 502/504. Top path=/v1/generate, upstream=edge-nginx-*. Host pool A has increased 502 ratio.

lee: I can see upstream resets from nginx logs: `upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header` across hosts edge-nginx-a02, edge-nginx-a04, edge-nginx-a05.

nina: Metrics: connection queue depth on pool A increased x6, latency to backend service 'model-proxy' also spiked. Could be backlog at model-proxy or NLB saturation.

matt: Can we toggle degraded-mode routing (reduce fanout + disable non-essential hooks) for the gateway? Suggest: set ROUTE_FANOUT=1 on api-gateway-eu-west hosts.

sarah: Doing canary change on 2 hosts now. If OK, roll to remainder. I'll post commands.

sarah: `kubectl -n gateway set env deploy/api-gateway ROUTE_FANOUT=1 --selector=zone=eu-west-a --record` (canary)

ops-bot: Canary applied to zone eu-west-a (2 pods). Monitoring 2m window.

lee: logs from canary pods show 502s dropped by ~60% in 90s. CPU on model-proxy pods still high — scaling recommended.

nina: Scaling model-proxy +2 replicas in eu-west now: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment/model-proxy --replicas=6` — executing.

emily-cs: Customer impact: CS queue seeing ~12 mentions from large customers, mostly POST /v1/generate returning 502s. Estimated % of requests affected: ~2.1%. Drafting status page.

sarah: scaling + degraded-mode + retries reduced error-rate to 0.8% in 3m. Rolling out ROUTE_FANOUT=1 to remaining eu-west hosts.

ops-bot: Traffic normalized. 5xx rate back to baseline ~0.4%. Reverting canary flags in 20m post-mitigation to confirm stability.

sarah: - Incident mitigated, handoff to postmortem. Assigning follow-ups: investigate NLB healthcheck config, kernel TCP backlog, and model-proxy connection pooling. Emily please send customer comms.

emily-cs: Will send status update: we experienced degraded API responses for ~18m, mitigation performed, detailed postmortem to follow.

sarah: Thanks team. Paging closed. :white_check_mark:
